description: Verify that DUT opens 3 passive sockets and emits SYN,ACK on each received tester SYN (RFC 793 §3.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Multiple distinct LISTEN sockets, each on its own port, can co-exist. Variant of ESTAB_01 — same outcome but different ports per leg.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN on ports P1, P2, P3.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN to each port.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK for each leg.

[Pass condition]
All 3 SYN,ACKs observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_leg<n> — no DUT SYN,ACK for the corresponding leg

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked SYN on 3 passive sockets — normal
